HOLISTIC WELLBEING
Care, embedded in our DNA, is the guiding principle across all our initiatives. Our approach to wellbeing is thorough: we focus on nurturing associates as individuals. This forms the basis of our strategy that covers their physical, mental, and financial health.
We're proud pioneers, pushing the limits of wellness in our industry and reshaping corporate wellbeing. Wellbeing is placed at the core of our people strategy, making the health and happiness of our employees integral to our organisational fabric.
Championing Care
Initiatives
We recognise that wellbeing extends beyond the individual and encompasses the broader community and environment. Thus, through our Holistic Wellbeing initiatives, we extend services to valued Ciplaites and their dependents without financial burden.
Walk2Fit Step Challenge
The most awaited wellness initiative, the Walk2Fit Step Challenge aims to foster consistent positive habits, focusing on long-lasting health improvements and sustainable lifestyle changes. The 7-month long journey sees Ciplaites taking steps, with their teams and family members, towards holistic wellbeing.
Everyone comes together and participates in the #FitnessBootcamp to ensure they are well-prepared and equipped for this invigorating challenge.
Mental Health Toolkit
Our conversations with our colleagues allowed us to understand the dilemmas they face at work, and as a result, create a unique solution for them through the mental health toolkit. Through activities and games, the employees understood:
The importance of mental health.
Signs of distress: approaching the counsellor versus managing them individually.
Their current standing on mental health.
Grounding techniques, relaxation methods, colour therapy, affirmations/power of gratitude, etc.
Benefits provided specifically for mental health by Cipla.
The 2.0 version, for our senior leadership team, helped them:
Understand their team’s mental health through a quick questionnaire, and come up with an action plan basis the scores.
Handle crisis situations.
Take care of their own mental health.
Financial Wellbeing
We are committed to promoting financial wellbeing among our colleagues, by helping them become financially prudent and plan their finances smartly. To align with this mission, we have introduced several initiatives:
MiEarnedSalary: Flexibility to withdraw earned salary for unplanned financial emergencies.
MiCareFund: A crowdfunding platform for financial support during medical emergencies within the Cipla network.
All Things Money (ATM): A repository of byte-sized videos for life-stage money management.
Expert Webinars: Insights from financial experts on topics like investing, wealth creation, taxation, and debt management.
Life Stage Webinars: Addressing key financial questions at different life stages, including retirement planning, housing decisions, campus-to-corporate transitions, and taxation.
Our Financial Wellbeing Initiatives empower all Ciplaites to manage their finances wisely.

CIPLA UNIVERSITY
We place heavy emphasis on constant learning and growth through multiple routes, be it formal learning, social learning, coaching, or experiential learning. Our philosophy is to identify future skills and build a robust leadership pipeline.
Nourishing Careers
Cipla University serves as our strategic avenue for nurturing organisational capability in the distinctive OneCipla approach. Through this platform, we aim to empower every employee to access best-in-class learning opportunities that align seamlessly with business imperatives and role demands, fostering a culture of continuous learning.
Additionally, Cipla University enables digital transformation through relevant role-based interventions for digital capability building. Complementing these digital learning initiatives, Cipla University equips our associates with the tools to remain future- ready and well-informed about the latest developments in the areas of science & technology, business management, and leadership & innovation.
Leadership Academy Programs
We offer leadership development interventions catering to all levels of the leadership pipeline. With a dedicated focus on nurturing excellence, we are committed to equipping you with the knowledge, tools, and insights essential for growth.
CLAP
Equips leaders to transition from excelling in a specific domain to thriving in a more comprehensive role, effectively preparing them for elevated leadership roles in the times ahead.
ACE
Elevates overall management and leadership proficiency by fostering a profound understanding of functional domains, cultivating strategic acumen and honing essential business leadership capabilities.
LEADX
Aspires to create a reservoir of leaders, to fuel our succession pipeline for leadership talent over the next 5-10 years. This envisions future General Managers adept at overseeing expansive domains and resolving business challenges.
LEAP
This program holds immense value for first-line managers as it elevates their performance while easing the transition into leadership roles. Participants explore their identities with self- awareness and develop a strong personal brand.
IGNITE
Ignite is a flagship program for individual contributors, designed to fortify the existing leadership foundation while nurturing prospective leaders. It contributes to a bedrock leadership community within Cipla.

Home > Cipla Foundation
Cipla, through its Foundation continues its passionate journey of social change using the power of collaborations. We endeavor to empower vulnerable communities and keep them at the heart of all our CSR initiatives.
At Cipla, our purpose of Caring for Life guides our engagement with communities. Through Cipla Foundation, our CSR initiatives focus on improving access to essential care for underserved communities, while strengthening the systems that enable this care to reach more people sustainably.
Embedded within this approach, our programmes go beyond service delivery to build long-term, scalable impact, improving care outcomes and supporting community resilience. We work in close partnership with NGOs, government institutions, and domain experts to strengthen delivery models, deepen community trust, and enable effective, sustainable implementation as far as possible. Our CSR efforts are outcome-oriented and aligned with our vision of building an equitable, resilient, and inclusive society.
We have identified the following thematic areas, as part of our CSR strategy:
Health
Environmental Sustainability
Education
Skilling
Disaster Response

Governance of our engagement with communities
Our community initiatives are governed through a robust and well-defined framework designed to ensure accountability, transparency, and effective oversight. The CSR governance structure focuses, inter-alia, on monitoring programme performance, reviewing progress against approved plans, and assessing outcomes.

As a Trustee of Cipla Foundation, Mr M K Hamied continues to provide thoughtful leadership and guidance, playing a key role in shaping the Foundation’s CSR initiatives.
Our Governing Pillars


Board of Directors
Approves the CSR Policy and the Annual Action Plan, oversees CSR fund utilisation, and provides strategic oversight of project execution.
Cipla Foundation
Identifies, implements, and monitors CSR projects in line with Board‑approved plans, the CSR Policy, and applicable regulations. It maintains proper records for all our CSR initiatives and activities, and ensures that CSR funds are utilised efficiently and solely for community benefit in compliance with statutory requirements.

In FY 2025-26, four CSR Committee meetings were held to conduct quarterly reviews and evaluate the progress and effectiveness of CSR initiatives.
CSR Committee
Recommends the CSR Policy and Annual Action Plan to the Board, and reviews progress of CSR projects on an ongoing basis.

Mr. P. R. Ramesh
Chairperson of the Committee
Independent Director
Mr P. R. Ramesh graduated in Commerce from Osmania University, Hyderabad and is a Fellow Member of the ICAI. He retired as the Director of Deloitte & Touche Assurance & Enterprise Risk Services India on 31st March 2020 and has also served as a member of Deloitte Global Board and Deloitte Asia Pacific Board. Ramesh has over 40 years of professional experience across manufacturing, banking and financial services, technology, media, telecommunications, energy and resources and consumer business sectors. He has been associated with various Regulatory bodies such as SEBI Committee on Disclosures and Accounting Standards; Committee for Reforming the Regulatory Environment for doing Business in India; Technical Committee to review the form and presentation of the Balance Sheet of the RBI; IRDA Standing Committee on Accounting Issues and Invitee to the Committee set up by the RBI to assist in convergence to IFRS by banks and National Advisory Committee on Accounting Standards. He has been associated with various Industry Bodies such as CII representing on its National Council, Committee on Financial Reporting and its CFO Forum; National Executive Committee of FICCI and Past President of the of the Bombay Chamber of Commerce & Industry. He has also been member of Accounting Standards Board of ICAI, Vision and Restructuring Committee and Auditing Practices Committee of ICAI and the Secretarial Standards Boards of the ICSI. He has co-authored publication by CCH titled iGAAP – Financial Reporting Standards in India including a comparison with IFRS and is a member of Board of Studies and the Faculty of Commerce of Osmania University.

Mr P R Ramesh is also on the Board of Nestle India Limited, Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Limited, NSE Investments Limited, Tejas Networks Limited, Air India Limited, Air India Express Limited, ITC Hotels Limited, Larsen and Toubro Limited and Forum for Indian Accounting Research.

About Cipcal-500
Calcium is one of the most important minerals and plays a very important role in our body. It is necessary for the normal functioning of nerves, cells, muscles, and bone. If there is not enough calcium in the blood, the body takes calcium from bones, thereby weakening them. Cipcal-500 tablet is a combination of Calcium and Vitamin D3, that helps our body maintain calcium levels EVERYDAY!
Every tablet of Cipcal 500 contains Calcium Carbonate & Vitamin D3
1 - 2 tablets daily to be taken alongside regular diet.
Disclaimer - This information is for general awareness only and is not a substitute for medical advice from a Registered Medical Practitioner. Daily calcium and vitamin D needs may be met through diet, sunlight exposure, and/or supplementation. Everyday tiredness (थकान) may be associated with nutritional deficiencies, including calcium and vitamin D. When taken as part of a balanced diet along with regular physical activity and healthy lifestyle practices, calcium and vitamin D support bone and muscle health. Consult a qualified doctor before use.

About Us
At Cipla, we constantly work towards ensuring access to high quality and affordable medicines to support patients in need. Which is why, we have been trusted by health care professionals and patients across geographies for the last 8 decades.
Cipla, as an organisation has been built brick-by-brick on the foundation of care. Caring For Life has always been and continues to remain, our guiding purpose. Driven by the same purpose, we have extended our presence to 74 markets providing over 1,500 products across various therapeutic categories in 50+ dosage forms. To make healthcare more affordable globally, we are deepening our presence in the key markets of India, South Africa, the U.S. among other economies of the emerging world.
For over nine decades, making a difference to patients has inspired every aspect of Cipla’s work. Our paradigm-changing offer of a triple anti-retroviral therapy in HIV/AIDS at less than a dollar a day in Africa in 2001 is widely acknowledged as having contributed to bringing inclusiveness, accessibility and affordability to the centre of the HIV movement. A responsible corporate citizen, Cipla’s humanitarian approach to healthcare in pursuit of its purpose of Caring for Life and deep-rooted community links wherever it is present, make it a partner of choice for global health bodies and stakeholders.

Privacy Policy
This Privacy Policy applies to  Cipla Limited together with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and group Companies (“Cipla”, “we”, “our”, or “us”), in connection with our personal data processing activities. We are committed to respecting your privacy and safeguarding your personal data when you interact with us.
This Privacy Policy explains how and why we collect, use, disclose, store, and protect personal data when you access or use our websites, digital platforms, online services, and related interactions ( “Services”). It also describes the categories of personal data we process, the purposes and legal bases for such processing, the circumstances in which we may share personal data, the safeguards we implement, and the rights available to individuals under applicable data protection laws.
This Privacy Policy is intended to comply with applicable data protection laws, including the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR), the United Kingdom GDPR (UK GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CCPA/CPRA), the Washington My Health My Data Act (MHMDA), and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), 2023 (including applicable rules) in India, as well as other relevant applicable laws.
Scope 
This Privacy Policy applies to  the processing of personal data by Cipla and covers information relating only to identified or identifiable individuals in connection with the following interactions:
Visiting or interacting with our websites
Submitting information through online forms, portals, or enquiry channels
Registering for Services, programs, or communications
Using features that involve cookies or similar technologies
Communicating with us through digital channels, including email or online support
Accessing or using our website constitutes your acknowledgement of an agreement to this Privacy Policy and the applicable Terms of Use.
This Privacy Policy applies to all pages hosted on Cipla’s websites. It does not apply to third-party websites that may be accessible through links on our platforms. Such third-party websites operate under their own privacy policies, and Cipla does not assume responsibility for the processing of personal data by such entities.
Cipla maintains official pages and profiles on certain social media platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and X (formerly Twitter).
In relation to statistical and aggregated page insights or analytics provided by LinkedIn in connection with Cipla’s Company Page, Cipla and LinkedIn act as joint controllers for the limited processing of such data, in accordance with LinkedIn’s Page Insights Joint Controller Addendum, which forms part of LinkedIn’s user agreements.
For all other processing activities carried out on these platforms, the respective social media provider acts as an independent data controller. Users are encouraged to review the privacy policies of these platforms to understand how their personal data is processed.
Territorial Applicability
This Privacy Policy applies to the processing of personal data by Cipla across the jurisdictions in which Cipla operates, as well as to individuals who access or use our Services from different locations.
While data protection laws may vary by jurisdiction, Cipla applies consistent privacy principles across its operations and implements additional measures where necessary to comply with applicable local legal and regulatory requirements.
Personal Data We Collect & Process
We may collect and process personal data about you depending on how you access or use our Services. The personal data we collect falls into the following categories: 
a.) Information You Provide Directly
You may provide personal data to us when you:
Visit our website or social media pages and register for Services, programs, or communications or subscribe to updates or newsletters 
Apply for job opportunities through our online application portals 
Submit enquiries, requests, or feedback through online forms, email, or customer support channels  
Visit Cipla facilities or premises as a guest, vendor, or third-party service provider, and access our systems or guest Wi-Fi networks
Engage with us as a supplier, vendor, or business partner, including through a Chatbot that allows users or visitors to ask questions and receive automated responses. This processing is based on our legitimate interests and, where required, your consent.  The Chatbot collects and processes interaction data, including chat content and timestamps, for the purpose of responding to your queries. You are advised not to share sensitive personal data in the chat.  
Report an adverse event or product related issues. 
Personal data for the above purposes may include your name, contact details (such as email address and phone number), professional and employment-related information, health-related information (where relevant, for example in connection with adverse event reporting), product usage information and any other information you choose to provide voluntarily. 
In connection with adverse event reporting and product safety monitoring, such data is processed for purposes including monitoring the safety and quality of our products, investigating and responding to adverse events and product complaints, complying with applicable regulatory and legal reporting obligations, and reporting to health authorities and regulatory bodies, where required. 
b.) Information Collected Indirectly (Automatically or through Cookies and Similar Technologies)
When you access or use our Services, certain personal data may be collected automatically through technical means including through the use of cookies and similar tracking technologies. This data helps us understand how our Services are used and improve user experience.
Such personal data may include:
Internet protocol (IP) address
Browser type, approximate location, device type and operating system
Pages visited, links clicked, and time spent on the website
Date and time of visits and referring URLs
Information about your device, preferences, and interactions with the website.
Aggregate and anonymized statistical data (such as page views and engagement metrics, including those provided through our social media platforms such as LinkedIn).
Where required under applicable law, we obtain your consent before placing or using cookies and similar tracking technologies, except where such cookies are strictly necessary for the functioning of the website. Further details regarding our use of cookies and how you can manage your preferences are provided in the Cookies & Tracking section of this Privacy Policy.
c.) Information from Other Sources
In certain circumstances, we may receive personal data  about you from third-party sources, including analytics providers, technology partners, business partners, recruitment agencies, and publicly available sources, where such collection is permitted under applicable law. 
We collect and process such personal data in a manner that is proportionate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy. We ensure that such third parties are authorized to share your personal data with us and that appropriate safeguards are in place to protect such data in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
Sharing and Disclosure of Personal Data
We may share your personal data with third parties only where necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
Service providers and Business Partners
We may share personal data with trusted third party service providers and partners who support the operation of our website, provide technical, analytical or communication services, or assist with other business or operational functions. Such third parties are contractually obligated to process personal data only on our documented instructions, and to implement appropriate confidentiality and security measures.
Cipla Affiliates and Group Companies
We may share personal data with Cipla’s subsidiaries, affiliates, and group companies for purposes such as internal administration, operational support, business management, and other legitimate business purposes, in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws.
Legal and Regulatory Disclosures
We may process and disclose your personal data to third parties, including legal advisors and regulatory authorities, where necessary to:
Comply with applicable laws, regulations, court orders, or governmental requests.
Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.
Protect the rights, property, or safety of Cipla, its employees, users, or third parties.
Detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, cybercrime, or other unlawful or unethical activities.
Business Transfers
Your personal data may be transferred to a third party in connection with a merger, acquisition, restructuring, financing, sale of assets, or other similar business transaction. In such cases, appropriate safeguards will be implemented to ensure that your personal data remains protected in accordance with applicable laws.
Lawful Basis for Sharing
Where required under applicable law, our sharing of personal data is based on lawful grounds such as compliance with legal obligations, performance of a contract, or our legitimate interests, provided that such interests are not overridden by your rights and interests. In cases where required, we will obtain your consent prior to sharing your personal data.
Cookies and Similar Technologies
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, improve the functionality of our website, and understand how visitors interact with our digital platforms.
What are cookies?
Cookies are small text files consisting of letters and numbers that are placed on your device (such as a computer, tablet, or mobile device) when you visit a website. Cookies enable the website to recognize your device and store certain information about your preferences or past interactions.
Types of Cookies We Use
We may use the following categories of cookies on our website:
Strictly Necessary cookies: These cookies are essential for the operation of the website and enable core functionalities such as security, network management, and accessibility. These cookies cannot be disabled.
Functional cookies: These cookies enable enhanced functionality and personalization, such as remembering your preferences.
Analytics and Performance cookies: These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website, allowing us to improve performance and user experience.
Advertising or Targeting cookies: Where used, to deliver relevant content and communication. We do not knowingly use such cookies to track or profile children.
How we use Cookies
We use cookies to:
Ensure the security and proper functioning of the website.
Enable essential features and Services.
Analyse usage patterns and improve website performance.
Enhance user experience and usability.
Your choices and controls
Where required under applicable law, we obtain your consent before placing or using cookies, except for cookies that are strictly necessary for the functioning of the website. You can manage your cookie preferences through the cookie banner, preference settings, or other tools available on the website. You may also manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality and performance of the website.
Third party cookies
Some cookies may be placed by third party service providers who assist us in operating, analysing, and improving our Services. These third parties are permitted to use the information collected through such cookies only for the purposes specified by us and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
International Data Transfers
In certain circumstances, your personal data may be transferred to, stored, and processed in jurisdictions outside your country of residence, including in countries where Cipla or its service providers operate.
Where such transfers occur, we ensure that appropriate safeguards are implemented to protect your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. These safeguards may include the use of standard contractual clauses, intra-group data transfer agreements, or other legally recognized transfer mechanisms.
Where required under applicable law, we will obtain your consent prior to transferring your personal data outside your jurisdiction.
Data Retention
We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including to meet applicable legal, regulatory, or reporting requirements.
In determining the appropriate retention period, we consider factors such as the nature, sensitivity, and purpose of the personal data, as well as applicable legal obligations. Once personal data is no longer required, it is securely deleted, anonymized, or, where appropriate, archived in accordance with applicable data protection law.
Data Security:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. Such measures include, where appropriate
Access controls and authentication mechanisms
Encryption and data protection safeguards
System and network security monitoring
Regular security assessments and audits
Employee training and awareness program
We continuously review and enhance our security practices to address emerging risks and ensure the ongoing confidentiality, integrity, and availability of personal data. While we take reasonable steps to protect personal data using commercially acceptable security measures, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
User Rights
Subject to applicable data protection laws, you have certain rights in relation to your personal data. These may include the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data; restrict or object to its processing; and the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing where such decisions significantly affect you.
Where applicable, you may also have the right to data portability, the right to withdraw consent at any time, the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal data, and the right to not be discriminated against for exercising your rights. Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you may also have the right to nominate an individual to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity and to seek grievance redressal.
These rights are not absolute and may be subject to limitations under applicable law.
Where processing is based on your consent, you may withdraw such consent at any time. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before such withdrawal.
To exercise your rights, you may contact us at globalprivacy@cipla.com. We may request additional information to verify your identity before processing your request. We will respond within the timelines prescribed under applicable law.
If you are not satisfied with our response, you may file a complaint with your national supervisory authority.
Children and Vulnerable Individuals’ Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy of children and vulnerable individuals who may require enhanced safeguards when their personal data is processed. For the purposes of this Privacy Policy, a child includes individuals under the age of 13, or such other age as defined under applicable law.
We collect and process personal data relating to children and vulnerable individuals only where legally permitted and for legitimate, specific purposes, and take reasonable steps to minimise such collection. Where required under applicable law, we obtain verifiable consent from a parent, lawful guardian, or authorised representative prior to such processing.
We implement appropriate technical and organisational safeguards to ensure that such data is processed securely, fairly, and responsibly, and is protected against misuse, harm, or exploitation. We do not knowingly use such data for profiling, behavioural tracking, or targeted communications where restricted under applicable laws. 
If you believe that personal data relating to a child or vulnerable individual has been collected or processed without proper authorisation, please contact us at globalprivacy@cipla.com so that we can take appropriate action. Where required by applicable law, additional rights and protections may apply to children’s data, including the right to access, correction, erasure, and withdrawal of consent through a parent or lawful guardian.
Changes to This Policy
Cipla reserves the right to modify this Privacy Policy from time to time without prior notice. The updated version will be posted on this website with a revised effective date. We encourage you to review this Privacy policy periodically.
Contact Information
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data, you may contact us at:
Cipla Limited
Cipla House, Peninsula Business Park, 
Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel, 
Mumbai – 400013, India
Email: globalprivacy@cipla.com
We will respond to your request within the timelines prescribed under applicable data protection laws.

Beware of Recruitment Fraud and Fake Recruitment Emails
Certain individuals and recruitment agencies posing as authorised recruitment agencies of Cipla India and/or its group companies (“Cipla India”) are trying to lure potential job seekers with job offers and appointment letters and asking for a security deposit or other cash payments for interviews. They are found corresponding through fake letterheads and bogus mail addresses of @cipla.com domain name, making job offers and appointment letters using the details of Cipla India.
Cipla India strictly follows a formal recruitment process through its own HR department and does not outsource interviews or selection of prospective employees to any individuals or agencies. No security deposit or fees (refundable or non-refundable) are required at any stage of the recruitment process. Cipla India strongly recommends against potential job-seekers willingly responding to such illegal solicitation and Cipla India shall not undertake any liability or responsibility thereof. Instead, immediately reach us at feedback@cipla.com or call us on toll-free number 1800-229-121 and assist us in taking appropriate action to curb such mala fide activities.

Collection of Personal Information

Passive Collection of information: Cipla Websites may collect information about your visits to Cipla Web sites without you actively submitting such information. This information may be collected using various technologies, such as cookies, Internet tags, and web beacons. The Website may capture some of this information, such as the URL of the website you just visited, Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, GPS location data, mobile phone service provider, details of operating system, the browser version of your computer, etc.  Passive information collection technologies can make your use of the Website easier by allowing Cipla to provide better service, customise sites based on consumer preferences, compile statistics, analyse trends, and otherwise administer and improve the Website. Such information collected by these technologies cannot be used to identity you without additional identifiable information.
Intended Use of Personal Information
Cipla shall collect, store and use your information in compliance with all applicable laws.
Spamming
We do not support “spamming".
Non-Disclosure of Information
Personal information on the Website may be accessed by Cipla, by certain companies with which Cipla may conduct joint programs, and by individuals and entities with whom Cipla contracts to carry out business activities for Cipla.
Cipla does not sell or rent your personal Information with anyone else.
Cipla may share the personal information with third-party, if it is required for further processing or connection to its business. During this time the information shared will be in accordance with the confidentiality agreement with the third party and applicable law for the intended purpose for which the Information was originally collected and shall ensure all such third parties comply with Cipla’s Data Protection and Privacy Policy and Procedure.
We may release your personal information when we believe release is required to comply with applicable law. We may release personal information if, in our judgement after review, the release is compelled by law or regulation.
Protection of personal information
Cipla will maintain adequate technical and organisational security measures to protect Personal Information.
As a policy, Cipla secures each web page that collects personal information; however, the confidentiality of personal information transmitted over the Internet will not be guaranteed. We urge you to exercise caution when transmitting personal information over the Internet.
Cipla is not obliged to store your Information for a period which is beyond the intended purpose for which such Information was collected or submitted or to stay in compliance to applicable laws and Cipla Policies and Procedures.
Links to other websites
This Privacy Policy applies only to Cipla's websites. Cipla may provide links to other websites, which we believe, may be of interest to you. Cipla is not responsible for the content on such website, your access to such website links, security of personal information that you provide or any information collected by that website. The risk of accessing such websites is solely yours.
Cookies
Cookies are alphanumeric identifiers with small amount of data that is commonly used as an anonymous unique identifier. These are sent to your browser from the website that you visit and are stored on your computer’s hard drive. Please note, a cookie in no way gives us access to your computer/device and cookies cannot access any other information on your computer/device.
Our Website uses these cookies to collect information and to improve our Service by making your interaction with us faster They may be used for the purposes of managing your preferences, maintaining and optimizing security, marketing, communication, analytics, and research.
We majorly use below types of cookies:
Essential Cookies or Strictly Necessary Cookies – These cookies are essential to the functioning of our Website and for you to move around the Website. Without these cookies, certain features cannot function. No information about your browsing habits is gathered by these cookies.
Functional Cookies – These cookies remember how you prefer to use our Website and improve the way our Website works. These remain on your computer/device for a pre-defined period of time.
Performance Cookies - Some cookies help us with the performance and design of our Website. For example, these cookies show us statistics, which are the most frequently visited pages on the Website, help us record any difficulties you have with the Website, and whether our publicity is effective or not.
Targeting or Tracking Cookies - On certain pages of our Website, we use cookies to help us understand your interests as you browse the Website, so we can tailor and deliver to you a more personalised service in the future. This assists us in delivering relevant, interest-based information to you.
At any time, you also have the option to change /control your cookies through your browser settings. However, if you do turn off cookies in your browser, you will not be able to fully experience some of the features in our website.
Use of our websites and mobile application by children
Cipla does not knowingly collect or use any personal information from children (we define "children" as those who are younger than 18 years of age) on this Website. We do not knowingly allow children to communicate with us or use any of our online services. If you are a parent or guardian and become aware that your child has provided us with information, please contact us and we will work with you to address this issue.
Right to your personal information on our Website
Right to access: You have the right to ask for a copy of your personal data and to verify how we are processing it.
Right to rectification: If you believe we have inaccurate or incomplete information about you, you have the right to ask us to correct or update it.
Right to be forgotten: In certain circumstances, you have the right to ask us to remove or erase your personal data from our records.
Right to object: You have the right to object to processing of your personal data. You also have the right not to be subjected to any automated decision making or profiling.
Right to restriction of processing: You have the right to ask us to restrict processing of your personal data in cases where the data is inaccurate, or the processing of the data is unlawful. This does not restrict Cipla from processing of your personal data for legal and regulatory requirements.
Right to withdraw consent: If we process your personal data based on your consent, you can withdraw your consent at any point of time.
Right to portability: You have the right to ask us to transfer your data to you, or any other third party.
In all communications to Cipla, please include the e–mail address used for registration (if applicable), the Website address and explanation of your request. If you would like to delete or amend your personal information and are contacting us by e-mail, please put "Deletion Request" or "Amendment Request", as applicable, in the subject line of the e-mail. We will do our best to respond to all reasonable requests in a timely manner.
Complaints and Grievances
Any complaints, abuse or concerns with regards to the processing of personal data provided by you or breach of these terms must be reported to globalprivacy@cipla.com.
Change in Policy
Cipla reserves the right to amend this Privacy Policy without prior notice to reflect technological advancements, legal and regulatory changes and good business practices. If Cipla changes its privacy practices, a new Privacy Policy will reflect those changes and the effective date of the revised Privacy Policy will be set forth in this paragraph.

Cipla Ltd. engages in the manufacture and distribution of healthcare products and bulk drugs. It operates through the following segments: Pharmaceuticals and New Ventures. The Pharmaceuticals segment develops, manufactures, sells and distributes generic or branded generic medicines as well as active pharmaceutical ingredients. The New Ventures segment includes the operations of the two wholly owned subsidiaries, Cipla Health Ltd., a consumer healthcare company and Cipla BioTec Pvt. Ltd, which is into the business of Biosimilars. The company was founded by Khwaja Abdul Hamied in 1935 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Access to Palliative Care
Palliative care focuses on improving the quality of life of individuals living with serious illnesses by addressing pain, distressing symptoms, and psychosocial needs of patients and their families. In India, access to such care remains limited, with only about 4% of those in need currently receiving palliative care support. Cipla supports the expansion of palliative care through its CSR initiatives by focusing on capacity building of healthcare providers and forging strategic partnerships with healthcare institutions and communities across the country.
1 Cipla Palliative Care and Training Centre
Established in 1997 in Pune, the Cipla Palliative Care and Training Centre ("CPC") is one of India's earliest dedicated palliative care centres. CPC was set up to provide free and holistic care to patients living with life-limiting illnesses, especially cancer. At a time when palliative care was still emerging in India, CPC helped to shape a care model that looks beyond disease treatment to address the broader needs of patients and their families.

CPC follows a Family Care Model that recognises how serious illness affects the whole family. It supports both patients and caregivers through pain and symptom management, emotional support, spiritual care, counselling, and help during bereavement. Delivered by a trained multidisciplinary team, care at CPC is continuous, personalised, and responsive to family needs.

The 49-bed facility at CPC offers comprehensive inpatient services, complemented by outreach initiatives such as home-based care and hospital partnerships through NGO collaborations.

Highlights of Cipla's Palliative Care Intervention FY 2025-26
Our work at the CPC has inspired us to support quality palliative care services across the country. We continue to partner with governmental, nongovernmental and community-based organisations to provide direct palliative care services to patients and increase awareness about palliative care.

2A. Integrating Palliative Care into Public Healthcare Systems
We work closely with governments and public institutions to strengthen palliative care services within existing health infrastructure. This includes supporting training of healthcare professionals, strengthening human resources, and enabling multidisciplinary care.

Cipla Foundation serves as the technical lead and, in partnership with Aga Khan Health Services ("AKHS"), supports the Government of Maharashtra in rolling out the Maharashtra State Palliative Care Programme. The programme aims to operationalise palliative care at the district level across the state.
2B. Palliative Care Partners Meet 2025
The theme of the second Palliative Care Partners Meet was ‘Empathy, Equity and Excellence – Strengthening Palliative Care through Partnerships.’ The meeting provided a platform to review progress since the previous year, share learnings, and jointly plan the future of palliative care in India for the next three years.

Key priorities under the three-year roadmap include:
Explore the integration of non-cancer conditions such as thalassemia, neurological disorders and respiratory illnesses into palliative care service delivery;
Developing digital data systems roadmap to strengthen monitoring, reporting, and evidence-based decision-making;
Promote innovations and best practices in palliative care, and
Plan a strategy for partner-level integration of the Saath-Saath helpline into outreach and training programmes.
2C. Palliative Care Beyond Cancer
We believe palliative care should be inclusive and accessible to all, not limited to cancer alone. We recognise that people living with heart diseases, COPD, kidney disorders, and Alzheimer's disease also need ongoing support to manage pain, symptoms, and quality of life. Our efforts extend palliative care services to address the needs of these patient groups.

The story of 56 year old Deepika, a homemaker diagnosed with dementia and Parkinsonism, reflects the transformative impact of this care model Deepika began experiencing early symptoms such as forgetfulness, slowed movement, and withdrawal from social interactions. Over the next two years, her condition gradually worsened. Following a fall that resulted in a fracture, she became completely dependent on her family for even the simplest daily tasks.

Launched in October 2021, Saath-Saath is a pan-India palliative care helpline supported by an Al-enabled chatbot, offering vital support to patients, families, and caregivers across India. Led by trained professionals, it offers free personalised multilingual support in Hindi, English, Marathi, Kannada, Telugu and Bengali through a tollfree number.

Primary Healthcare System
Mobile Healthcare Units ("MHUs")
As part of our community programme, we bring primary healthcare closer to underserved populations, with a focus on the elderly, women, and children.
In FY 2025-26, we provided primary healthcare through MHUs to over 17,000 individuals across four states (Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra) and delivered more than 1,08,000 medical consultations.
This programme is implemented through MHUs operated by HelpAge India and delivers comprehensive medical consultations directly at the community level. It provides targeted support to vulnerable groups and is integrated with the local health system through referral services, ensuring continuity of care wherever required.
Other Medical Support
Strengthening India’s Respiratory Healthcare Ecosystem by establishing the Cipla Foundation Centre for Pulmonary Medicine at the Tata IISc Medical School, Bengaluru
As a global leader in respiratory care, Cipla has pioneered solutions that improve the lives of patients living with asthma, COPD, and other chronic respiratory conditions. With rising air pollution and an increasing respiratory disease burden, the need for advanced pulmonary care has never been more urgent.
Against this backdrop, Cipla's partnership with Indian Institute of Science ("IISc"), Bengaluru, marks a milestone with the establishment of Cipla Foundation Centre for Pulmonary Medicine at the Tata IISc Medical School.
The Centre will advance research and develop India specific guidelines for COPD, ILD, asthma, and other lung conditions. It will also train pulmonologists and allied specialists, contributing to long-term human resource capacity in respiratory medicine. By integrating care, training, and research, the Centre aims to deliver sustainable and practical outcomes that enhance the quality of life for patients requiring pulmonary and palliative care support.
Supporting patients with thalassemia and other blood disorders
We remain committed to supporting patients with thalassemia and other blood disorders from underserved communities. In partnership with Sankalp India Foundation and Arpan Thalassemia and Sickle Cell Society, we facilitate access to life-saving and life-enhancing medical care.

Through our Education focused initiatives, we are contributing to the creation of a conducive and enhanced learning environment in schools, making education inclusive and equitable for children.
Igniting curiosity in children through the ‘Mobile Science Lab’
Cipla Foundation, in partnership with Agastya International Foundation supports the Mobile Science Lab (‘MSL’) initiative in government and government aided schools. These labs take science models and hands-on experiments directly to students and teachers, especially in rural areas where schools often lack proper science laboratories.

The MSLs help students to learn science through hands-on experiments. This practical method makes learning more engaging and helps students to better understand scientific concepts by connecting them to real-world situations. The programme encourages curiosity, creativity, and confidence among children.

Scholarship Support for Continuity in Education
Mr. M K Hamied, Trustee, Cipla Foundation engages with students during the Pratham Mumbai Exposure Visit 2025
Cipla Foundation has been providing continuous scholarship support, in partnership with Pratham Mumbai Education Initiative to children who have lost one or both parents as well as children who were expected to drop out of school due to financial constraints, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic. Through sustained scholarship assistance, the project has supported over 450 students since 2022 for their educational continuity, prevented dropouts, and enabled the affected students to pursue their academic aspirations with dignity and stability.

Disaster Response
Reaching out to provide immediate relief to communities affected by disasters.
Health
Environmental Sustainability
Education
Skilling
In response to severe flooding in Dharashiv district, Maharashtra, Cipla Foundation partnered with BAIF Institute for Sustainable Livelihoods and Development to deliver timely disaster relief. Bhoom was among the most affected taluka of Dharshiv district, with widespread damage to homes, agricultural land, and basic infrastructure impacting vulnerable households.
We supported 300 vulnerable households across three villages in Bhoom taluka through ration kits which included basic nutritional requirements, hygiene essentials, and safe drinking water. This initiative strengthened community resilience and reinforced the importance of trusted local partnerships in crisis response.

Australia
Cipla Australia has a vast pipeline of products that are supplied in Australia as well as US & EU. Millions of Australians have access to a Cipla manufactured product through our community pharmacy partners around Australia.
Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities are TGA approved as well as being USFDA (USA) and MHRA (UK) approved. Cipla Australia has over 200 registered formulations with TGA through partnerships with market leaders and on its own. The list of registered medicines includes OTC (Over the Counter), Prescription and hospital medicines. We are also involved in helping Australians access medicines through the SAS (Special Access Scheme). Cipla has earned a name for maintaining world-class quality across all our manufacturing units, products and services. Globally, our patent filing includes drug substances, drug products, platform technologies, IP on polymorphs and crystallinity, and medical devices.

Über Cipla
Cipla Deutschland
Cipla Deutschland, eingetragen unter Cipla Europe NV, ist eine hundertprozentige Tochtergesellschaft von Cipla Limited, einem globalen Pharmaunternehmen, das führend im weltweiten Verkauf von Inhalatoren für die Atemwege ist.(Cipla Jahresbericht 2022-2023)
In Deutschland verfügt Cipla über ein Portfolio von Arzneimitteln in den Therapiebereichen Atemwegserkrankungen, Onkologie, HIV, Herz-Kreislauf und Urologie und weitet sein Engagement ständig weiter aus. Mit der Unterstützung unserer globalen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsteams liefern wir qualitativ hochwertige Arzneimittel und weiten unser Engagement in Deutschland ständig durch ein wachsendes Angebot an Marken- und Generikaprodukten aus.
Cipla Global
Bei Cipla arbeiten wir ständig daran, den Zugang zu erschwinglichen Medikamenten und hochwertiger Pflege zu verbessern. Aus diesem Grund genießen wir seit acht Jahrzehnten das Vertrauen von medizinischem Fachpersonal und Patient:innen in vielen Ländern der Welt.
Cipla wurde als Organisation Schritt für Schritt auf der Grundlage der Fürsorge aufgebaut. Caring For Life war und ist immer unser Leitmotiv. Mit der gleichen Zielsetzung haben wir unsere Präsenz auf über 80 Länder ausgeweitet und bieten über 1.500 Produkte in verschiedenen therapeutischen Kategorien in über 50 Dosierungsformen an. Um die Gesundheitsversorgung weltweit erschwinglicher zu machen, verstärken wir unsere Präsenz in den Schlüsselmärkten unter anderem in Asien, Afrika, Europa und den USA.
Die Arbeit von Cipla ist in jeder Hinsicht davon geprägt, etwas für die Patient:innen zu bewirken. Unser paradigmatisches Angebot einer dreifachen antiretroviralen Therapie gegen HIV/AIDS zu einem Preis von weniger als einem Dollar pro Tag in Afrika im Jahr 2001 ist weithin anerkannt und hat dazu beigetragen, Inklusion, Zugang und Bezahlbarkeit in den Mittelpunkt der HIV-Bewegung zu stellen. Als verantwortungsbewusstes Unternehmen ist Cipla mit seinem humanitären Ansatz im Gesundheitswesen ein zuverlässiger Partner für globale Gesundheitsorganisationen und Interessengruppen.

Das Credo von OneCipla
Unsere Grundwerte leiten uns bei jedem Gespräch, jeder organisatorischen Entscheidung und sind ein Anker für das Handeln unserer Mitarbeiter. Wir überprüfen sie ständig und passen unsere Strategien an, um für unsere Stakeholder stets relevant zu bleiben.
ZIELSETZUNG – INSPIRIERT
VERANTWORTUNG – ZENTRIERT
INNOVATION – ANGETRIEBEN
INTEGRITÄT UND VERTRAUEN – VERANKERT
SPITZENLEISTUNG – FOKUSSIERT
Wir sind ein globales Pharmaunternehmen, das sich konsequent für das Leben einsetzt (Cares for Life) und seine Verpflichtungen gegenüber allen unseren Interessengruppen – Patient:innen, Aufsichtsbehörden, Kund:innen, Partnern, Mitarbeiter:innen, Investoren und der Gemeinschaft – einhält.
Das ist unser Credo bei OneCipla.
Wir sind zielorientiert
Cipla wurde Stein für Stein auf dem Fundament von Care aufgebaut. Diese Zielsetzung treibt uns an – eine Zielsetzung, die 82 Jahre jung ist und im Mittelpunkt all unserer Gedanken und Pläne steht und unser Handeln bestimmt.
Indem wir uns von Zielen inspirieren lassen, suchen wir nach Maßnahmen und Lösungen, die nachhaltig sind und zu „Caring for Life“ führen.
Wir sind verantwortungsbewusst
Wir sind für unsere Handlungen und Ergebnisse verantwortlich – wir teilen die Lorbeeren und übernehmen die Verantwortung. Wir garantieren, dass jeder die gleichen Chancen auf Erfolg hat. Eigenverantwortung und Rechenschaftspflicht sind das Wichtigste. Jede Entscheidung, die wir treffen, muss den langfristigen Erfolg von Cipla und das übergeordnete Ziel von „Caring for Life“ im Auge behalten.
Wir sind innovationsgetrieben
Wir sind der Überzeugung, dass Innovation radikaler und umwälzender ist als Verbesserung und daher eine entscheidende Komponente ist, um die Organisation zu ihrem Ziel zu führen. Die eigene Leidenschaft, der Wunsch, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, neu zu erfinden, bringt uns der Erfüllung unseres Ziels nur einen Schritt näher.
Wir sind von Integrität und Vertrauen geprägt
Wir tun das Richtige, auf die richtige Art und Weise – auch wenn niemand zusieht. Wir stellen unsere Integrität in den Mittelpunkt all unserer Bemühungen und sind stolz auf das Vertrauen, das unsere Interessengruppen in uns setzen und das wir in sie setzen.
Wir sind auf Spitzenleistungen fokussiert
Unser Ziel ist es immer, den Goldstandard im Gesundheitswesen zu setzen und alles zu tun, um dem Motto „Caring For Life“ treu zu bleiben.
Jeder Schritt nach vorn wird mit dem Wunsch unternommen, uns selbst zu übertreffen, wobei wir unsere eigenen Leistungen und die Fortschritte des Markts als Maßstab nehmen.

Wir verfügen über mehr als 1500 Produkte in 65 Therapiegebieten, die in über 50 Darreichungsformen erhältlich sind. Diese Fähigkeiten reichen von der Entwicklung eines einfachen Moleküls bis hin zu hochkomplexen Verbindungen mit mehreren Chiralitätszentren., die sich durch ihre Erschwinglichkeit und höchste Qualität auszeichnen. Unsere Kapazitäten umfassen eigene und lizenzierte Anlagen, die sowohl das Generika- als auch das Biotech-Geschäft unterstützen. Unsere Investitionen in die Produktion umfassen die Entwicklung neuer Arzneimittelverabreichungssysteme, die Förderung der Infrastruktur zur Unterstützung von API- und Formulierungsentwicklungen sowie die Stärkung von Plattformtechnologien.

Unser Produktionskapital
Nach dem Prinzip „Caring for Life“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, die Erschwinglichkeit von Arzneimitteln weltweit zu verbessern, indem wir in unser Produktionskapital investieren, und zwar in cGMP-konforme und weltweit zugelassene Anlagen.
Unsere Investitionen in das Produktionskapital umfassen die Entwicklung neuer Verabreichungssysteme für Arzneimittel, die Förderung von Technologie- und Automatisierungsinitiativen, die Verbesserung der nachhaltigen Produktion und die Unterstützung von API- und Formationsentwicklungen.
Verbesserung der nachhaltigen Produktion
Zur Reduktion der Auswirkungen unserer Geschäftstätigkeit auf die Umwelt haben wir in allen unseren Produktionsstätten eine Reihe von Maßnahmen umgesetzt, um die Effizienz beim Ressourcenverbrauch zu steigern. In den Geschäftsjahren 2022/2023 und 2021/2022 entfielen 1,59% bzw. 2,30% unserer Gesamtinvestitionen auf die Reduktion von ökologischen und sozialen Auswirkungen unserer Produkte und Herstellungsverfahren.
Erfolge 2022 bis 2023
Geringerer CO2-Fußabdruck in der Anlage in Goa:
Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) in der Anlage in Indore
Geringerer Polyethylenverbrauch im Werk Baddi
Digitalisierung in der Produktion
Im Geschäftsjahr 2022/2023 wurde Ciplas Indore Oral Solid Dosage (OSD)-Anlage vom Weltwirtschaftsforum als „Leuchtturm der fortgeschrittenen vierten industriellen Revolution“ (4IR) ausgezeichnet.
Die OSD-Einrichtung von Indore führte diesen Weg mit mehr als 30 Industrie 4.0-Anwendungsfällen an, die das industrielle Internet der Dinge, Digital Advanced Analytics, Natural Language Processing, Robotic Process Automation usw. umfassten. Diese revolutionären Technologien führten zu einer Steigerung der Produktivität um 23 % , einem Rückgang von spezifischen Treibhausgasemissionen um 28% und Qualitätssteigerung.
Die Einführung von Industrie 4.0 revolutioniert unsere Produktionsprozesse. Die beiden Motoren Analyse und Automatisierung haben unseren Betrieb auf ein neues Niveau gehoben, indem sie die Zugänglichkeit der Ausrüstung verbessert, potenzielle Kapazitäten freigesetzt und die ökologische Nachhaltigkeit gefördert haben. Industrie 4.0 ermöglicht es uns somit, zukunftsfähige Anlagen zu schaffen und unseren Weg der Digital Analytics Automation (DAA) voranzutreiben.
Die hochmodernen Produktionsanlagen von Cipla sind cGMP-konform und entsprechen den nationalen und internationalen Standards. Mehrere in diesen Anlagen hergestellte Darreichungsformen und Wirkstoffe sind weiterhin von wichtigen internationalen Aufsichtsbehörden zugelassen oder präqualifiziert, darunter die US-amerikanische FDA, MHRA (Großbritannien), TGA (Australien), BfArM (Bundesinstitut für Arzneimittel und Medizinprodukte), SAPHRA (Südafrika), das Department of Health (Kanada), INVIMA (Kolumbien) ANVISA (Brasilien), die Danish Medical Agency, die WHO und die Gesundheitsministerien verschiedener Länder.

Qualität
Wir sind der Überzeugung, dass der Schlüssel zur Stärkung des Fundaments einer verantwortungsvollen Marke darin liegt, bei allem, was wir tun, konsequent hohe Qualitätsstandards zu erreichen. Qualität ist in jeder Phase unserer Geschäftstätigkeit verankert wie beispielsweise in der Beschaffung, Produktion, Lieferung und sicheren Produktentsorgung. Unsere Hauptschwerpunkte zur Erreichung hervorragender Qualität sind: Produktlebenszyklusmanagement, unternehmensweite Qualitätskultur sowie Automatisierung und Digitalisierung. Mit diesen Schwerpunkten in unserem Qualitätsmanagement erfüllen und übertreffen wir die aktuellen Erwartungen von Aufsichtsbehörden wie CDSCO, FDA, MHRA, TGA, MCC, WHO usw.
Effektives Produktlebenszyklusmanagement

Produkttests
Bei Cipla führen wir Produktqualitätsprüfungen im eigenen Haus durch und folgen dabei anerkannten Spezifikationen und Methoden. Unsere Produktionsstätten sind mit spezialisierten Labors für die Qualitätskontrolle ausgestattet, in denen Materialien und Arzneimittel mit modernen Instrumenten getestet werden. Wir führen proaktiv Vorsorgetests für aufkommende Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbedenken durch.
Bekämpfung Von Arzneimittelfälschungen
Sichere Produktvernichtung
Verbesserung der organisationsweiten Qualitätskultur
TRUST - „Towards a Robust, Unified and Sustainable (quality) Transformation“ ist ein Programm, das darauf abzielt, die Qualität innerhalb von Cipla zu verbessern. Es umfasst 25 Einheiten in den Bereichen Formulierungen und API. Mit TRUST wollen wir die Qualität unserer Produkte durch Verhaltensänderungen, Peer-Learning, Förderung des Engagements und Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten verbessern.
Darüber hinaus setzen wir unseren Weg zum Aufbau technischer Fähigkeiten durch die Durchführung verschiedener Schulungen fort.
Wir setzen auf Digitalisierung und Automatisierung
Neuausrichtung der Qualität
Qualitätsrisikomanagement (QRM)
Neuausrichtung Der Qualität
Im Rahmen unserer Initiative zur Neuausrichtung der Qualität haben wir vier laufende Projekte, um die Produktivität zu steigern, Fehler zu minimieren und die Einhaltung von Vorschriften sicherzustellen. Dazu gehören die Einführung eines elektronischen Testdatenblatts für papierlose Qualitätskontrollvorgänge, die Digitalisierung des jährlichen Produktqualitätsprüfungsprozesses, die Verwendung mobiler Cobots für die automatisierte mikrobielle Überwachung im Reinraum und die Automatisierung der Analyse der Gleichmäßigkeit der abgegebenen Dosis für Dosierinhalatoren.

Atemwege
Cipla ist stolz auf seine lange Tradition und sein starkes Engagement bei der Behandlung von Asthma und chronisch obstruktiver Lungenerkrankung (COPD). Wir sind der weltweit zweitgrößte Hersteller von inhalativen Atemwegsmedikamenten, was eine zuverlässige Versorgung und nachhaltige Preise für unsere Medikamente gewährleistet. Unsere Präsenz in der gesamten Behandlungskette und unser breites Angebot an Medikamenten- und Gerätekombinationen haben Cipla in verschiedenen globalen Märkten zu einem führenden Unternehmen im Bereich der Atemwegserkrankungen gemacht.
Asthma
Vor über 60 Jahren löste ein winziger Hauch Medizin eine therapeutische Revolution aus, die später zum Kern der Inhalationstherapie von Cipla werden sollte. Heute helfen wir der Welt, besser zu atmen! Wir verfügen über das weltweit größte Sortiment an Inhalationsmedikamenten und -geräten. Für Patient:innen unterschiedlicher Altersstufen in unterschiedlichen Krankheitsstadien haben wir ein passendes Medikament, eine passende Darreichungsform und ein passendes Verabreichungssystem für die Asthmabehandlung.
Asthma bei Kindern
Wir kümmern uns um die Lungengesundheit von Kindern. Asthma bei Kindern ist nicht dasselbe wie Asthma bei Erwachsenen. Während bei Erwachsenen einige der typischen Symptome wie Atemnot, pfeifende Atmung, Husten und Engegefühl in der Brust auftreten, zeigen Kinder möglicherweise nicht die gleichen Symptome. Bei den meisten asthmatischen Kindern ist chronischer Husten das auffälligste Symptom. Ein Husten, der länger als 3 bis 4 Wochen anhält, könnte ein Hinweis auf Asthma bei Kindern sein. Unser breites Angebot an Medikamenten- und Gerätekombinationen deckt so gut wie alle Altersgruppen ab, auch Kinder.

COPD ist eine vermeidbare und behandelbare Krankheit, die es erschwert, Luft aus der Lunge zu entleeren. Bei einer gesunden Lunge sind die Atemwege und Lungenbläschen elastisch und flexibel. Sie dehnen sich aus, füllen sich mit Luft und nehmen beim Ausatmen wieder ihre ursprüngliche Form an. Diese Elastizität erleichtert das Ein- und Ausströmen der Luft. Bei Menschen mit COPD kehren die Lungenbläschen nicht mehr in ihre ursprüngliche Form zurück, und die Atemwege können geschwollen oder verengt werden.
COPD kann auch zu einer erhöhten Schwellung und Schleimproduktion (Sputum) führen. Die Atemwege können teilweise blockiert sein, wodurch es noch schwieriger wird, Luft in die Lunge hinein und aus ihr heraus zu bekommen. Zu den frühen Symptomen einer COPD gehören Atemnot und Husten. Dies kann sich mit der Zeit verschlimmern und zu Lungenanfällen führen.

HIV / AIDS
Seit über zwei Jahrzehnten stehen wir zu unserem Motto „Niemandem soll etwas vorenthalten werden“ und engagieren uns im Bereich HIV/AIDS. In unserem Kampf gegen die Krankheit haben wir über 15 Einzel- und Kombinationsmedikamente entwickelt, die die HIV-Therapie weltweit revolutioniert haben. Unsere herausragenden wissenschaftlichen Ressourcen und Bildungsplattformen helfen Ärzt:innen, die Krankheit effektiv zu bewältigen. Unser Kampf gegen HIV/AIDS hat den Zugang zu Medikamenten weltweit verbessert. Und mit unserem anhaltenden Engagement in Forschung und Entwicklung kann sich die Welt auf weitere Fortschritte im Kampf gegen HIV/AIDS freuen.
Im Jahr 2001 führte Cipla die weltweit erste empfohlene 3-in-1-Kombination mit fester Dosierung zur Bekämpfung von AIDS ein. Sie wurde in Entwicklungsländern zu einem Preis von weniger als 1 USD pro Tag angeboten, während in den meisten Ländern der Welt über 12.000 USD pro Patient:in und Jahr anfallen. Diese Behandlung erhöhte die Therapietreue, verringerte die Belastung durch Tabletten und bedeutete für Millionen von Menschen in Entwicklungsländern die Möglichkeit einer wirksamen Bekämpfung ihrer HIV-Erkrankung.
Wir haben auch Pionierarbeit im Bereich pädiatrischer HIV-Infektion geleistet. Wir gehen auf die Bedürfnisse verschiedener HIV-Patient:innen ein, darunter schwangere Mütter, Neugeborene, Kinder und Erwachsene. Es ist keine Überraschung, dass heute rund 1 Million Patient:innen auf der Welt unsere antiretroviralen Medikamente einnehmen und bei regelmäßiger Therapie jahrelang leben und ein nahezu normales Leben führen können.
Cipla verfügt heute über das weltweit größte Sortiment an antiretroviralen Produkten, die von der WHO und der US-amerikanischen FDA zugelassen sind. 25 unserer antiretroviralen Medikamente sind gemäß PEPFAR zugelassen und von der WHO vorqualifiziert. Unsere antiretroviralen Medikamente werden in mehr als 115 Länder und verschiedene Gesundheitsministerien geliefert.

Retouren & Ausgleich von Lagerwertverlusten
Sie können Ihre direkt von uns bezogenen Produkte jederzeit direkt und wirtschaftlich retournieren. Für eine reibungslose Abwicklung beachten Sie bitte nachfolgende Hinweise.
Voraussetzungen für eine Retoure
Die Retouren müssen direkt bei Cipla Europe NV erworben worden sein.
Grundvoraussetzung für die Vergütung von Retouren ist die vorherige Anmeldung der Retoure bei unserem Logistikdienstleister Movianto Deutschland. Ohne vorherige Anmeldung erfolgt keine Vergütung.
Produkte, die der Kühlkette unterliegen, sind von einer Retoure ausgeschlossen.
Retourengründe & Vergütung
Sind folgende Retourengründe erfüllt, vergüten wir 100% des erstattungsfähigen Betrags:
bei Verfall, ab 6 Monate vor und bis 1 Monat nach Ablauf des Verfallsdatums
bei Erstbevorratung
bei Bestellfehlern innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Anlieferung
bei Bruch oder Anlieferschäden innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Anlieferung
für Produkte mit AV-Kennzeichnung bis 3 Monate nach AV-Setzung.
für Produkte mit Qualitätsmängeln bei Rückruf eines Produktes innerhalb 6 Monate
Berechnungsbasis für verschreibungspflichtige Produkte ist der tagesaktuelle Herstellerabgabepreis (HAP/ApU).
Lagerwertverlustausgleich
Als Grundlage zur Erstattung eines Lagerwertverlustausgleiches muss ausschließlich ein Direktbezug stattgefunden haben, ausgenommen hiervon sind Festbetrags-Anpassungen.
Die Erstattung des LWV erfolgt auf Basis des ApU bis 3 Monate nach erfolgter Preissenkung (jeweils zum 1./15. eines Monats).
Um den Aufwand für beide Seiten wirtschaftlich zu gestalten, erstatten wir Beträge ab einer Summe von 15,00 €. Bitte sammeln Sie Ihre
Lagerwertverlustausgleiche pro Quartal bis zum Mindestbetrag, bevor Sie diese einreichen.

Anwendung eines Inhalators*
Sind Sie unsicher, wie Sie Ihren Inhalator richtig verwenden? Diese leicht verständliche Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung von Breathefree zeigt Ihnen alles, was Sie wissen müssen, um einen Druckdosieraerosol-Inhalator korrekt zu benutzen.
*Gemäß Packungsbeilage
Gebrauchsinformation 100/6 mg
Gebrauchsinformation 200/6 mg
Über das Anleitungs­video
Dieses Video bietet eine klare Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung zur korrekten und sicheren Anwendung Ihres Inhalators. In diesem Tutorial erfahren Sie:
Die vier Hauptteile des Inhalators: Behälter, Mundstück, Mundstückkappe und Dosiszähler.
Die richtige Vorgehensweise bei der Vorbereitung und Anwendung des Inhalators.
Wie Sie den Inhalator vor der ersten Anwendung oder nach längerer Nichtbenutzung „vorbereiten“ (primen).
Die wesentlichen Schritte sind das Schütteln des Inhalators, das vollständige Ausatmen und das koordinierte Drücken des Behälters, während Sie langsam und tief einatmen.
Die Bedeutung des Atemanhaltens nach dem Inhalieren, damit das Medikament richtig aufgenommen wird.
So lesen Sie den integrierten Dosiszähler ab, um Ihre verbleibenden Dosen zu verfolgen.
Anwendung eines Inhalators: Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung
Wenn Sie diese Schritte befolgen, können Sie den größtmöglichen Nutzen aus Ihrem Medikament ziehen.
Vorbereitung:
Aufrecht sitzen oder stehen: Sorgen Sie für eine bequeme, aufrechte Position.
Öffnen und schütteln: Entfernen Sie die Schutzkappe vom Mundstück und schütteln Sie den Inhalator einige Sekunden lang kräftig. Dadurch wird das Arzneimittel richtig vermischt.
Einnahme der Dosis:
1
Entfernen Sie die Schutzkappe vom Mundstück und überprüfen Sie, ob das Mundstück frei von Schmutz und Staub sowie von anderen Fremdkörpern ist.
2
Atmen Sie langsam und so tief wie möglich aus.
3
Halten Sie das Druckbehältnis senkrecht mit dem Behälterboden nach oben und umschließen Sie das Mundstück mit den Lippen. Beißen Sie nicht in das Mundstück.
4
Atmen Sie langsam und tief durch den Mund ein und drücken Sie, kurz nachdem Sie mit dem Einatmen begonnen haben, fest auf den oberen Teil des Inhalators, um einen Aerosolstoß freizusetzen. Wenn Sie einen schwächeren Händedruck haben, kann es leichter sein, den Inhalator mit beiden Händen zu halten. Dazu wird der Inhalator mit beiden Zeigefingern von oben und beiden Daumen von unten gehalten.
5
Halten Sie den Atem so lange wie möglich an und nehmen Sie anschließend den Inhalator aus dem Mund. Atmen Sie langsam aus. Atmen Sie nicht in den Inhalator hinein.
Abschluss:
Kappe wieder aufsetzen: Setzen Sie nach der Anwendung immer die Mundstückkappe wieder auf, um sie sauber zu halten.
Mund ausspülen: Es ist sehr wichtig, den Mund nach der Einnahme mit Wasser auszuspülen und das Wasser auszuspucken. Schlucken Sie es nicht.
Wichtige Hinweise:
Inhalator vorbereiten: Bevor Sie Ihren Inhalator zum ersten Mal verwenden oder wenn er länger als eine Woche nicht benutzt wurde, müssen Sie ihn vorbereiten. Entfernen Sie dazu die Schutzkappe, schütteln Sie den Inhalator und geben Sie zwei Sprühstöße in die Luft ab – weg von Ihrem Gesicht.
Dosiszähler: Der Inhalator ist mit einem Dosiszähler ausgestattet, der anzeigt, wie viele Dosen noch verbleiben. Wenn die letzten 40 Dosen übrig sind, wechselt die Anzeige von Grün auf Rot, um Sie darauf hinzuweisen, dass Sie bald einen neuen Inhalator benötigen. Wenn der Zähler „0“ erreicht, ist es Zeit, den Inhalator zu entsorgen.
Reinigung: Um Ihren Inhalator sauber zu halten, empfiehlt es sich, das Mundstück mindestens einmal pro Woche mit einem trockenen Tuch oder Papiertaschentuch abzuwischen. Verwenden Sie kein Wasser zur Reinigung des Inhalators
Koordination: Die Anwendung eines Inhalators erfordert eine gute Koordination zwischen dem Drücken des Inhalators und dem gleichzeitigen Einatmen. Falls Ihnen dies schwerfällt, sprechen Sie bitte mit Ihrem Arzt oder Apotheker über die Verwendung eines Spacer-Geräts (Inhalierhilfe), das die Einnahme Ihres Medikaments erleichtern kann.

Home > Cipla Foundation
Cipla, through its Foundation continues its passionate journey of social change using the power of collaborations. We endeavor to empower vulnerable communities and keep them at the heart of all our CSR initiatives.
At Cipla, our purpose of Caring for Life guides our engagement with communities. Through Cipla Foundation, our CSR initiatives focus on improving access to essential care for underserved communities, while strengthening the systems that enable this care to reach more people sustainably.
Embedded within this approach, our programmes go beyond service delivery to build long-term, scalable impact, improving care outcomes and supporting community resilience. We work in close partnership with NGOs, government institutions, and domain experts to strengthen delivery models, deepen community trust, and enable effective, sustainable implementation as far as possible. Our CSR efforts are outcome-oriented and aligned with our vision of building an equitable, resilient, and inclusive society.
We have identified the following thematic areas, as part of our CSR strategy:
Health
Environmental Sustainability
Education
Skilling
Disaster Response

Governance of our engagement with communities
Our community initiatives are governed through a robust and well-defined framework designed to ensure accountability, transparency, and effective oversight. The CSR governance structure focuses, inter-alia, on monitoring programme performance, reviewing progress against approved plans, and assessing outcomes.

As a Trustee of Cipla Foundation, Mr M K Hamied continues to provide thoughtful leadership and guidance, playing a key role in shaping the Foundation’s CSR initiatives.
Our Governing Pillars


Board of Directors
Approves the CSR Policy and the Annual Action Plan, oversees CSR fund utilisation, and provides strategic oversight of project execution.
Cipla Foundation
Identifies, implements, and monitors CSR projects in line with Board‑approved plans, the CSR Policy, and applicable regulations. It maintains proper records for all our CSR initiatives and activities, and ensures that CSR funds are utilised efficiently and solely for community benefit in compliance with statutory requirements.

In FY 2025-26, four CSR Committee meetings were held to conduct quarterly reviews and evaluate the progress and effectiveness of CSR initiatives.
CSR Committee
Recommends the CSR Policy and Annual Action Plan to the Board, and reviews progress of CSR projects on an ongoing basis.

Nuestro credo
Our work is not just about making medicines, It is about making a difference.
Dr. Y.K Hamid | Chairman, Cipla
Nuestro credo
Nuestros principales valores guían cada conversación y decisión corporativa, a la vez que determinan las medidas que toman nuestros empleados. Realizamos una constante revisión de nuestros valores y recalibramos nuestras estrategias para seguir siendo un referente en el sector.
Este es nuestro credo.
“Empresa farmacéutica global con un foco constante en el cuidado por la vida y que cumple los compromisos que tiene con todos los actores que intervienen en el sistema de atención sanitaria: Pacientes, organismos regulatorios, clientes, socios, empleados, inversores y la sociedad en su conjunto”.
Conoce la historia de Cipla
El compromiso, nuestra inspiración
Cipla se ha construido pieza a pieza sobre la base del cuidado. Este propósito, que ha permanecido durante 90 años y está en el centro de todos nuestros pensamientos y planes, es nuestro motor y guía nuestras acciones. Nuestro compromiso nos inspira a poder encontrar medidas y soluciones que sean sostenibles y nos encaminen a nuestro objetivo del «cuidado por la vida».
La responsabilidad, nuestra guía
Somos responsables de nuestras acciones y resultados, compartimos nuestros éxitos y asumimos nuestra responsabilidad. Es imprescindible que garanticemos que todos tengamos las mismas oportunidades de éxito. La responsabilidad y rendición de cuentas son fundamentales y por eso, todas las decisiones las tomamos teniendo en cuenta el éxito a largo plazo de Cipla y el objetivo superior del «cuidado por la vida».
La innovación, nuestro impulso
Creemos que innovar es más eficiente y transformador que hacer mejoras. La innovación, por tanto, es un componente fundamental para conducir a la empresa hacia nuestro objetivo. La pasión que tenemos y nuestro deseo de desafiar las convenciones y reinventar la forma en que hacemos negocios, nos acercan un paso más a nuestro propósito.
Estamos anclados en la integridad y confianza
Hacemos lo correcto y de la manera correcta, incluso cuando nadie nos observa. Ponemos nuestra integridad en el centro de todos nuestros esfuerzos y estamos orgullosos de la confianza que nuestros grupos de interés depositan en nosotros y de la que nosotros depositamos en ellos.
Y este es nuestro Credo OneCipla.
La excelencia, nuestro foco
Siempre aspiramos a establecer el estándar de excelencia en la atención sanitaria y hacemos todo lo posible por mantenernos fieles a nuestro lema «Caring for Life» («el cuidado por la vida»). Cada paso adelante lo damos con el deseo de superarnos, utilizando nuestros propios logros y los avances del mercado como referencia.

Nuestra historia
1935
Fundación
Las operaciones comienzan en un bungalow alquilado en Bellasis Road 289, Bombay Central.
El Dr. K. A. Hamied fundó los laboratorios químicos y farmacéuticos conocidos como “CIPLA” en Bombay.
1939
Visita de Mahatma Gandhi
Tuvo lugar el 4 de julio de 1939 y nos inspiró para producir medicamentos esenciales y hacer que la India fuera autosuficiente en materia de atención médica.
1972
Liderando la terapia respiratoria
Líderes en la India, CIPLA produjo su primer inhalador propio en 1972. El lanzamiento del salbutamol marcó un hito en el tratamiento del asma y la EPOC.
1997
Centro de cuidados paliativos y capacitación
CIPLA estableció este centro en Pune para brindar atención holística y gratuita a pacientes con enfermedades terminales y a sus familias.
2001
Trabajando por el VIH en el mundo
CIPLA ofreció la primera combinación a dosis fija de tres medicamentos para el tratamiento del VIH/sida por menos de 1 dólar al día a Médicos Sin Fronteras en todo el mundo.
2026
Nuestros logros, hoy
CIPLA se encuentra entre los dos principales laboratorios farmacéuticos de la India (por número de marcas) dentro de los 100 más importantes del mercado, con varias marcas líderes en diferentes categorías. Además, es la empresa número uno en medicamentos con receta (por valor) en Sudáfrica y la de mayor crecimiento de genéricos en Estados Unidos durante los últimos cuatro años.
